FORM.AppraisalAddendumText: -::- -::- -:SITE COMMENTS:- There seems to be no apparent adverse easements, encroachments, or other adverse conditions that might affect the marketability of the subject property.Subject is a legal conforming site at this time. -:ADDITIONAL COMMENTS:- Scope of work :- The minimum I performed is in the scope of work section of the limiting conditions section of this report. The appraiser certifies and agree's that the appraisal meets all elements listed on the appraisers certification. The appraiser inspected the interior/exterior of the subject property, defined market boundaries and researched all sales within the past 12 months using CT MLS in addition to the assessors office sales ratio books. The appraiser included one active listing from the subject market area. - Two of the Subject property units are rented at the time of inspection and all units utilities on and working well. - The appliances were all tested and functioning well at the time of the inspection and no value was attached or given to personal property. a) "The appraisal was prepared in accordance with the requirements of the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice." b) The appraisal was prepared in accordance with the requirements of Title XI of the Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery and Enforcement Act of 1989, as amended (12 U.S.C 3331 et seq.) and any implementing regulations. - The subject as improved the land is legally permissible meeting all uses legally permitted that are potential highest and best uses; financially feasible since the continued use of the existing improvement do represent the highest net value of the sites at the time; physically possible with the current use given the parcel size, shape, topography and since privacy is more vital in that part of the state meets the physical possibility test; and the land current use provide maximum return generating the highest net return making it the maximally productive use at this time. - The location of some comparables across a major freeway or boundary or over a mile have no measurable negative impact on value or marketability. - The subject's heating system is typical and have no negative affects value or Marketability. - This report was based on effective age which is defined as the estimate of the age of a structure based on its utility and physical wear and tear. Effective age could be the actual age of the structure or could be more or less than the actual age, depending on maintenance, remodeling, structural reconstruction, removal of functional inadequacies, zoning change, modernization of equipment and other improvements to the structure including additions. - Similar homes in the subject neighborhood have sold in a range of $40-65 per sf. The question becomes what will the market pay for an extra dollar amount for an extra square feet in this report. After extracting lot value, and using paired sales of the same quality and condition, it was determined that $50/sf is the market reaction to differences in GLA when the average change in sales prices were calculated simply by dividing the difference in sales price by the difference in square footage since it helps closed up the gaps within adjusted sale prices of the sales in the report. Comparable sales 1,2 and 3 was used for the analysis in the report. - Paired Sales Analysis. This method is usd for the adjustments in the report where the subject property is compared to comparable sales, and adjustments are made to the comparable sale for their differences. A adjustments are made on the feature that is different between subject and the comparables used in the report. The more paired sales that are analyzed, the more supportable the adjustment. Adjustments are made either as a dollar adjustment or as a percentage adjustment depending on the differences that needed an adjustment. - Carbon monoxide and smoke detectors are present at the time of inspection and working fine - In the report, the appraiser has adhered to the measurement with the ANSI Z765-2021 standard and the home measured and each measurement was exactly to whole numbers. - Paired sales data analysis was used to isolate and estimate some characteristic's effect on value regarding some features of the subject when compared to the comparables. Using the paired sales analysis below it can be seen that all sales comps are similar based on the adjusted sale prices. The mean of the below chart is within the estimated market value of the report and also with the range of homes price in the subject market area. - Comp 1, sold for $620,000 with adjusted sales price of $649,300 and $270.54 for adjusted sales price/sf - Comp 2, sold for $645,000 with adjusted sales price of $650,300 and $185.75 for adjusted sales price/sf - Comp 3, sold for $650,000 with adjusted sales price of $628,850 and $156.08 for adjusted sales price/sf - Subject market area analysis indicates/shows a steady percentage change within two percent of the list prices when compared to sale prices. When the percentage change is compared to the adjusted sales prices in the report,it becomes with one percent and an indication of a more stable market at this time with all thing being equal.
